# Regression test for https://go.dev/issue/82237:
# "go list -export" should not reuse export data across GOARCH values.

env GOEXPERIMENT=golistexportnewformat
env GOOS=linux

env GOARCH=amd64
go list -export -f '{{.Export}}' p.go
cp stdout amd64.txt

env GOARCH=386
go list -export -f '{{.Export}}' p.go
! cmp stdout amd64.txt

-- p.go --
package p

import "unsafe"

const PtrSize = unsafe.Sizeof(uintptr(0))
